column3: The pre-phase: a business driver, mandate, or event creates the initial case for change, before formal Discovery begins.
Current-state discovery, pain-point quantification, and future-state scope definition; baseline framework pulse.
Future-state design, governance charter set-up, communication plan and stakeholder map construction.
Technical build/configuration proceeds alongside participative-management and communication cadence.
SIT/UAT testing runs alongside training delivery and Knowledge/Ability assessment; Divergence Pattern checks begin.
Cutover execution, go-live communication, and hypercare activation — the sharpest instance of the two-clock problem (Exception E3).
Elevated floor-coaching support, sentiment-regression monitoring and incident-linked coaching, tapering as metrics stabilize.
Reinforcement mechanisms embedded into standard performance management; 60/90-day checkpoint audits begin.
Formal Refreeze confirmation from evidence, sustainment sign-off, and hand-off to Business-as-Usual ownership.
